groups.activity: Ghoul Alpha Assassinate bounty (level 15-25 tier, MR 1)

rows.label: Stubba Blueprint
rows.note: 50% per Ghoul Rictus Alpha kill; 3.57-4.85% per reward roll in the bounty stages otherwise
rows.alt: Market, or the Maggor Assault Pack

conditions: The bounty is on Konzu's board only while the recurring Ghoul Purge event runs.
Only Alphas drop the Stubba; plain Ghoul Rictus do not. Alphas rise after 20 Ghoul kills in the marked area, with 5 minutes total.
bonuses: Quartakk shares this farm, so do both in one session.
Repeat the low tier: about a minute per bounty, and Rescue stages can chain two in about 1.5 minutes.

disclosures.title: between events
disclosures.body: Olympus (Mars, Disruption) spawns Ghouls, and the Ghoul Eruption modifier floods the mission. Reports there farmed Tak & Lug and Tonkkatt parts; the Stubba blueprint drops only from the Rictus Alpha, which may not show. Bring Nekros. If no Alpha appears, wait for the next Purge.

disclosures.title: Defector Rescue
disclosures.body: A Thumper shockwave can one-shot the defector and fail the bounty. Keep it away from Thumpers or slow enemies with Zenurik's Temporal Drag.

rows.label: Stubba
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 45 Grokdrul, 25 Coprite Alloy, 4,485 Ferrite, 2 Neurodes
